summary.en: Creative AI platform for video, image, and multimedia generation.
summary.zh: 创意 AI 平台，用于视频、图像和多媒体生成。

title.en: Runway ML API Key - Creative AI Platform | Get Model Key
title.zh: Runway ML API Key - 创意 AI 平台 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Runway ML API key for creative AI. Access video, image and multimedia generation tools.
description.zh: 获取 Runway ML API Key，访问创意 AI。使用视频、图像和多媒体生成工具。

en: Runway ML is a creative AI platform focused on video, image, and multimedia generation, with APIs for Gen-series models and related tools.
Teams use Runway for text-to-video, image workflows, and other production creative pipelines documented at docs.runwayml.com.
getModelKey only links the official Runway account API page. We do not sell Runway API access.
zh: Runway ML 是面向视频、图像与多媒体生成的创意 AI 平台，提供 Gen 系列等模型及相关工具 API。
团队常用其做文生视频、图像工作流等生产创意链路，文档见 docs.runwayml.com。
getModelKey 只链到 Runway 官方账号 API 页面，不出售 Runway API 访问权限。

en: Open https://app.runwayml.com/account/api and sign in to your Runway account.
Create or view API credentials in account settings as shown in the product.
Follow docs.runwayml.com to authenticate and call video/image endpoints.
Rotate credentials in the same account UI if they are exposed.
zh: 打开 https://app.runwayml.com/account/api 并登录 Runway 账号。
按产品界面在账号设置中创建或查看 API 凭证。
参照 docs.runwayml.com 完成鉴权并调用视频/图像接口。
若凭证泄露，请在同一账号界面轮换。

answer.en: Video generation is a core focus, alongside image and other creative multimedia tools.
answer.zh: 视频生成是核心能力之一，同时覆盖图像等其他创意多媒体工具。

question.en: Where do I confirm plan limits?

answer.en: Only in Runway’s official app billing/account pages and docs—not on getModelKey.
answer.zh: 请只在 Runway 官方应用账单/账号页与文档中确认，不以本站为准。

question.zh: getModelKey 卖 Runway Key 吗？

answer.en: No. Obtain API access exclusively through Runway’s official account API page.
answer.zh: 不卖。请只通过 Runway 官方账号 API 页获取访问权限。
